name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
description: The creature deals an extra 13 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 ft. of an ally of the creature that isn't incapacitated and the creature doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.
